name: Add Checklist
description: Adds a new checklist to a card. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-cards/#api-cards-id-checklists-post).

configurable_props.name: boardId
configurable_props.label: Board
configurable_props.description: The Trello board you wish to select

configurable_props.name: idChecklistSource
configurable_props.label: Copy from Checklist
configurable_props.description: The ID of a checklist to copy into the new checklist

configurable_props.name: pos
configurable_props.label: Position
configurable_props.description: The position of the checklist on the card. One of: top, bottom, or a positive number.
